sections.changelog:
Added

  • Accordion icon choice: ten presets (plus to minus, plus to cross, chevrons, arrows, triangles). Each icon turns when an answer opens.
  • Icon button: optional circle, square or rounded square background behind the icon, with its own background color.

Changed

  • General tab: design options are grouped in one "Design" block — theme styles toggle, icon, button shape, colors, then fonts. Open/close options live in a separate "Behavior" block.

Fixed

  • Turning on "Use theme styles" no longer resets the icon color and font settings to defaults on save.
